title: spec(ui): a list-view grouping field can order its groups only by its own value, so a period label (Q4 2026 / Sep 2026) cannot be grouped in time order without a second grouping level — add an order-by field to GroupingFieldSchema
body:
Filing gate **① a defect with a named landing site** (an app is carrying a workaround for a missing spec key; hotcrm AGENTS.md says the gap belongs here). Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

## What is seen

HotCRM's 销售预测 list groups by `period_start` (desc) and then by `period_label`, because grouping on `period_label` alone sorts the periods as text ("Sep 2026 → Q4 2026 → Q4 2025 …"). The result is two header rows for every single forecast: 「周期起始 10月1日 · 1」 then 「Oct 2026 · 1」 then the row — six forecasts take 18 rows. [45-crm_forecast.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/45-crm_forecast.png). The view's own comment (`src/sales/views/forecast.view.ts` ~:40–63) says why: `GroupingFieldSchema` is `field` / `order` / `collapsed`, with no key that orders one field's groups by another.

`reach:` a named producer (HotCRM `forecast.view.ts`, shipped) and the public UI, measured once.

## Expected

`GroupingFieldSchema` gains an `orderBy` (a field of the same object whose value orders the groups; default = the grouping field), the server-side grouping query (#14556's shape) sorts groups by it, and objectui's grouped grid renders the group label from `field` while ordering by `orderBy`. HotCRM then drops its outer level (one line in the view).

Cross-layer: spec first, then the engine's grouping aggregate, then objectui — the usual parent + per-layer children if triage files it that way.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectstack "view grouping sort groups by a different field than the grouping field" → 1 hit, #14556 (closed: server-side grouping, per-group counts, paging), which does not add an ordering field. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §3.2.
